verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag platform that could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in assistant. The MCP server lets external LLM coding assistants manage flags, and llms.txt serves docs to AI agents, but both are adjacent capabilities belonging to other stories, not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
